title: Fix the Reused Stream
description: The program should count elements matching a filter, and then separately compute their sum.
expectedBehavior: The program should print '3 12' — 3 even numbers (2, 4, 6) summing to 12.
actualProblem: A Java Stream can only be consumed by one terminal operation. After stream.count() runs, the stream is already closed; calling stream.mapToInt(...).sum() on it throws IllegalStateException: 'stream has already been operated upon or closed'.
explanation: Each Stream pipeline can be traversed exactly once by its terminal operation. To perform two separate computations over the same data, a fresh stream must be created for each one (e.g. by calling .stream() again from the source collection).
